verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is built around bulk scanning: it can scan entire GitHub orgs, multiple sources, and many secret types in one invocation (`--org=`, `--only-verified`, 800+ detectors run simultaneously), and a live probe confirmed a real scan returning 8 findings across multiple secret types in one pass. It also supports scripted/headless CLI use for CI pipelines, fitting automation-depth needs, though it lacks a dedicated batch-API for arbitrary bulk item processing beyond scan targets.
